prompt: The chart and table below show the results of a survey of library users at a university.
scenario: A survey of library users at a university.
requirements: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

visualData.title: Categories of library users; Library user satisfaction (%)
notes: The pie chart shows full-time undergraduates 44%, full-time postgraduates 25%, part-time postgraduates 16%, distance-learning users 8%, and academic staff 7%.
